candidate_seal_algorithm: SHA-256 of unframed Git commit payload, independently reconstructed and verified against its framed Git object ID
encoding: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, 2-space indentation, final LF; hash the complete file.
finding_disposition: Independent double listing and explicit 0/1/error ancestry decisions address the two review6 findings. Nine immutable recorded controls were inspected. Production workflow and all runtime members are byte-identical to review6.
review_basis: Read-only source, Git identities and existing control receipts. The positive bundle is an offline fixture. Actual staging requires the correct official origin, complete Git history, final unpublished decision-bearing commit and fresh reconciliation with the provider. This is not a launch decision, booking or live review.
